candidates.title: How to do a Pike Push-Up
candidates.description:
Learn how to do a Pike-Push-up. Here’s a great press variation that works as an early introduction to more inverted forms of push-ups. Maintaining the pike position provides additional challenge to the core.
 
Place hands and feet on the ground with the hips flexed in a pike position and knees near lock-out but not hyperextended. Maintaining spinal stability and kinetic chain alignment, lower the head toward the floor. Stabilize and press into the floor to return to starting position. Only move within the range that is controllable. Reduce shoulder shrugging.
